thesis.line: NIL decides how many of those 10–12 Florida can actually buy.

rooms.dek: Both tackle spots. Most expensive portal buy. 2027 true freshmen are not Year-1 SEC starters.
rooms.hunt: Power-conference tackle who can start in 2027. Length, 2+ years left. Two if the budget holds.

rooms.dek: One-year safeties leave a hole. One 2027 commit is not enough.
rooms.hunt: Range-and-tackle safety who can play SS or STAR in Year 1. 2+ years left.

rooms.dek: Secondary is a portal shop. Quality starter snaps still look thin.
rooms.hunt: Press-man corner with starter snaps. Not a depth body.

rooms.dek: Interior only if the staff needs a Year-1 two-gap piece.
rooms.hunt: Year-1 interior who can two-gap. Not a roster filler.

rooms.dek: Only if the 2027 starter is not already on the roster. A portal QB taxes the tackle budget.
rooms.hunt: Do not shop a quarterback until that call is made.

rooms.dek: Only a difference-maker. Not a depth body.
rooms.hunt: A Year-1 MIKE/WILL who changes the front. Pass if he is just a count.

rooms.dek: Pass-rush JACK piece. Not a 30-man roster filler.
rooms.hunt: A rush piece who can play JACK in Year 1.

rooms.dek: Headcount is fine. A true WR1 only if the staff wants a Year-1 dude.
rooms.hunt: Do not spend a 10–12 slot on a body. Royal is a freshman.

rooms.dek: Do not spend a portal slot here unless the backfield situation changes.
Not a 10–12 slot unless a difference-maker falls.
